hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

measurement_protocol.cold: Successful idle-only KV flush before each measured cold batch; does not mean cold weights/JIT
measurement_protocol.warm: Identical immediate repeat without KV flush
measurement_protocol.aggregate_rate: Final API output token sum / complete batch wall time
measurement_protocol.decode_rate: (Final API completion tokens - first-content event cumulative tokens) / (last-content time - first-content time)

selected_profile.selection_scope: Best balanced tested profile, not a universal optimum or winner in every cell

kernel_evidence.known_lse_issue: All-masked-row +inf metadata also reproduced in stock FlashInfer; attention output passed comparisons and this SGLang wrapper discards LSE.

separate_fp8_contribution_validation.scope: Separate main-based PR kernel/config validation, not full-model validation of that source tree.

expert_oracle_relative_l2_percent.scope: Real checkpoint expert microbenchmark, not a model-accuracy delta.

limitations: These are historical serving results, not new full-model measurements of the packaged image.
The 1M context limit and parser flags were enabled after the throughput matrix.
Compact ragged verification failed the V4.1 Engram equal-block invariant at startup; no valid throughput was reported for it.
SPS cost calibration used explicitly simulated acceptance; those timings are not serving throughput.
The first screening client falsely rejected one-content-event quality answers with later EOS usage; the timing fix preserves those failures separately and does not alter sustained-speed formulas.
